# Tetracube

> Tetracube is a free falling-block puzzle you play in the browser at https://tetracube.fun. Four boards wrap around the sides of one isometric cube, and neighbouring boards share their corner columns, so a clear on one face can set off clears on the faces beside it.

Each face is 10 columns wide and 16 rows tall. The last column of one face is the first column of the next, so the tower is a ring of 36 columns. Clearing a row removes its two corner cells, which also belong to the neighbouring faces; their columns drop, and if that completes a row next door it clears too. That chain is a cascade, and each wave multiplies its score (×2, ×3, …). In Focus mode only the face you are looking at falls; in Live mode all four fall, the unwatched ones at half speed. There are two leaderboards, Focus and Live.

Controls. Keyboard: A S D F pick a face, ← → move, ↑ or X rotate, Z rotates back, ↓ soft drop, Space hard drop, L live mode, Esc or P pause, R restart, H high scores, M sound. Touch (phones, tablets, foldables): swipe to move, tap to rotate, swipe up to rotate back, drag down to soft drop, flick down to hard drop, tap a board in the map at the bottom to switch faces.

It is free, has no ads and needs no account. The source is open under the MIT license. It was made by HoneySpoons in one evening in October 2026.

## Play

- [Tetracube](https://tetracube.fun/): the game
- [High scores](https://tetracube.fun/scores): the live Focus and Live boards
- [About](https://tetracube.fun/about): how the corners work, controls, FAQ, how it was made
